value.deck: Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS will reach end of life on November 1, 2026, necessitating migration to a supported version to maintain security and vendor support.
shortVersion: Microsoft has formally announced the end-of-life (EOL) for Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS, effective November 1, 2026. This hard deadline signifies the cessation of all vendor support, including critical security patches and bug fixes, for any workloads still operating on this specific runtime version. The announcement is a direct vendor communication, establishing a definitive timeline for deprecation.

Data engineering teams currently deploying or maintaining applications on Runtime 10.4 LTS must prioritize migration to a currently supported Databricks Runtime. Failure to complete this migration by the EOL date will expose affected systems to unpatched vulnerabilities, escalating the threat model and potentially leading to compliance issues and operational instability due to lack of official support. This is not an implied risk but a direct consequence of unsupported software.
value.plainLanguage: Azure Databricks Runtime 10.4 LTS will stop receiving updates and support on November 1, 2026, requiring users to upgrade to a newer version to stay secure.

keyTerms.meaning: A specific long-term support version of the Apache Spark-based analytics platform offered on Microsoft Azure, providing an optimized environment for data processing and machine learning workloads.
